title_tr: Devre dışı bırakılan kullanıcı bildirim almaya devam ediyor
issue: A user who was deactivated by an admin keeps receiving notifications, for example when a task they created is completed or when someone mentions them in a comment. Deactivated accounts should not receive any notifications.

ground_truth.root_cause: NotificationDispatcher._deliver, the single place every event notification goes through, does not check whether the user is active before calling notify.
ground_truth.fix: In _deliver, return without notifying when self._users.get(user_id).active is False.
